# iosxe_voice_dspfarm_profile (Data Source)

This data source can read the DSPFarm Profile configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_dspfarm_profile" "example" {
  tag = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) dspfarm profile ID

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `associate_application` (String) Configure the application to associate
- `codec_g711alaw` (Boolean) Add the codec g711alaw
- `codec_g711ulaw` (Boolean) Add the codec g711ulaw
- `codec_g722_64` (Boolean) Add the codec g722-64
- `codec_g729abr8` (Boolean) Add the codec g729abr8
- `codec_g729ar8` (Boolean) Add the codec g729ar8
- `codec_g729br8` (Boolean) Add the codec g729br8
- `codec_g729r8` (Boolean) Add the codec g729r8
- `codec_ilbc` (Boolean) Add the codec ilbc
- `codec_isac` (Boolean) Add the codec isac
- `codec_opus` (Boolean) Add the codec opus
- `codec_pass_through` (Boolean) Add the codec pass-through
- `conference_participants` (String) Configure the maximum number of conferee per conference session
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `maximum_mtp_sessions_hardware` (Number) Configure the maximum hardware MTP sessions of this profile
- `maximum_mtp_sessions_software` (Number) Configure the maximum software MTP sessions of this profile
- `maximum_sessions` (Number) Configure the maximum sessions of transcode or conference profile
- `security` (Boolean) Enable security for the dspfarm service
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown or bring up the profile
- `trustpoint` (String) trustpoint label to use with this profile
- `type` (String) Configure the profile types
- `universal` (Boolean) Configure the transcode universal profile type
